subject: Q4 foundation: OKR slate stitching, resource triage & QBR playbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Q4 foundation: OKR slate stitching, resource triage & QBR playbook

Team —

Putting this thread together to get us aligned on the Q4 OKR slate that feeds into the Oct QBR packet. I attached the latest OKR_slate_v2.xlsx and a first draft of the QBR_playbook_v1.pdf. Key asks:

1) Owners and clear success metrics for the three platform-facing objectives (Serving runtime, Dedicated scale, Observability). I marked provisional owners in the sheet with comments.
2) Resource triage: which projects can be deferred or put into maintenance so we can fund two additional FTEs for infra work.
3) QBR deck: final content deadline is EOD Oct 13 — we need confirmed owner notes + 1 slide each.

Quick proposed plan:
- Today: leadership review (this thread) — minor edits only
- Oct 11: sync with product + applied ML to validate model onboarding metrics (Jonas + Karthik)
- Oct 12: compile QBR packet, circulate for comments

Alicia from Acme is looping in as a key customer we want to highlight (they have a big dedicated contract coming up). I copied procurement for timeline visibility.

Please reply with: 1) accept/adjust owner, 2) any items you want removed from the top-line slate to free capacity, 3) confirm who will draft the slide.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, GTM Strategy & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OKR_slate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), QBR_playbook_v1.pdf (doc), resource-triage-notes.md (notes)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 foundation: OKR slate stitching, resource triage & QBR playbook

Marissa — thanks, looks tight but doable. I reviewed OKR_slate_v2 and left inline comments on:
- "Dedicated scale" objective: suggest moving the reliability SLA target from 99.9 to 99.95 for paid tier only; keep 99.9 for free tier. That reduces scope for infra work on cross-tenant isolation.
- "Observability": propose adding one metric for "median token latency by route" so we can call out improvements in the QBR.

For resource triage: we can cold-start the A/B evaluation experiment (deprioritize) and pause the benchmarking expansion we planned for November; that frees ~0.6 FTE across infra + infra-eng. If we need two full FTEs, we'll still need to re-scope the roadmap for the model-ops work (Karthik, will need your call).

I can take the infrastructure slide for the QBR (1 slide + 3 bullets + 1 chart). Will aim to get a first draft by Oct 12 AM.

—Jonas

Thanks — a couple of risk notes and a small ask: 

Risk notes:
- If we move the SLA delta to 99.95 for paid tier, we need a mitigation note for cost impact (GPU hours spike during peak tests). Recommend we include a short "cost vs. benefit" callout in the infra slide.
- Observability median latency needs a baseline; I can pull week-over-week metrics but will need access to the request-route mapping that Product owns (Jonas/Karthik please coordinate).

Small ask: can Karthik confirm whether the two FTEs are headcount or contractor budget? That changes how we present ramp timing in the QBR (headcount = 8–12 week ramp, contractors = 2–3 weeks).

I'll draft the risk callouts and an appendix slide with baseline charts — will target Oct 12 COB for a first POA.

—Grace

Marissa, Jonas — thanks for the heads up and for flagging Acme as a customer spotlight. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Confirmed: Acme's procurement timeline remains on track for signing by Nov 2, but we need a short appendix showing our inferred latency and cost estimates for the dedicated offering. Can you include a short comparison table in the QBR appendix (two rows: current hosted vs projected dedicated)?
- We can provide a short testimonial quote once the dedicated integration pilot reaches the 10k token/day throughput milestone. That should align with Oct 26 pilot run date.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if that helps — propose Oct 11 10:00–10:20 PT.

Thanks — Alicia
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp

Thanks everyone — quick readout and next steps: 

- Owners confirmed: Jonas (Infrastructure + Dedicated scale slide), Grace (Observability & risk appendix), Karthik (Model onboarding metrics + resource plan).
- Resource decision: headcount ask approved in principle — I'll escalate to People for two IC hires; in parallel, we will plan contractor coverage for a faster ramp. Karthik, please indicate preference by EOD Oct 11.
- QBR content: Jonas and Grace will submit draft slides to the shared Drive folder by Oct 12 10:00 AM PT. I'll compile the packet Oct 12 PM and circulate for one round of comments Oct 13 AM. Final deck to execs Oct 14 AM.
- Acme appendix: Jonas, please add a two-row latency/cost table for hosted vs dedicated and drop the file in the Drive link. Alicia — thanks for the timing note; Oct 11 10:00 PT works for a quick sync.

I'll treat this thread as the official owner record. If anything changes, reply-all so we keep the audit of decisions.

—Marissa
VP, GTM Strategy & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
